name: openrecorder
description: A small native screen recorder with a local library, separate originals and temporary sharing. The plugin’s tools can organise and share recordings but cannot start one.

interface.longDescription: A compact native recorder controlled from the menu bar or tray and from its local Home page, with a movable camera bubble and an on-demand local library. Your agent can find, organise, open and share recordings and can stop a take when you ask; only you can start one. Preview: macOS 26.0 or later on Apple silicon; experimental Linux and Windows builds exist and have not been run on hardware. No Node.js or browser engine is bundled.
